questions.stem: A 35-year-old man begins attending therapy sessions to address long-standing feelings of anxiety and low self-esteem. During the sessions, the therapist utilizes the topographical theory of mind to help the patient better understand the underlying cause of his emotions and behaviors. According to this theory, which of the following represents the correct organization of the human psyche?
questions.stemHtml: A 35-year-old man begins attending therapy sessions to address long-standing feelings of anxiety and low self-esteem. During the sessions, the therapist utilizes the topographical theory of mind to help the patient better understand the underlying cause of his emotions and behaviors. According to this theory, which of the following represents the correct organization of the human psyche?

options.label: D
options.text: Sensorimotor, Preoperational, Concrete operational, Formal operational
